title: [CON2-10] Pinning in DM groups cannot be done
description: Review finding CON2-10: Pinning in DM groups cannot be done (lens CON2). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:445, :465; spec/14-jmap.md:153. Fix: §5.2.6 grants pin rights "in a group chat, admins" but pins are `sequenced-v1` "ordered by the Space's blind sequencer"; DM groups have no Space, no sequencer (05:28 "including in every DM group") and no defined admins. The §14.4.1 rule "If `sequencer` is absent, `sequenced-v1` types in the Space are read-only" covers Spaces only. Full text: notes/review2/CON2-verified.md and notes/review2/CON2.md.
